name: TASHA RAW
line: Seven captains is a committee. Who's holding the game on offense when you need a single answer?

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Mm. The question ain't 'who', it's 'what'. The team named what they believe in.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Belief is a vibe sheet. The end zone needs a name.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Whew.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Mm.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Mm.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Hm.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: The end zone has names. The tape shows who they are.
delivery: calm, definitive, with a slight nod

name: TASHA RAW
line: Right.

name: TASHA RAW
line: The tape shows a running back and a guard. Who's calling the play in that huddle?

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Whew.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: The huddle's got a quarterback. The committee ain't a question, it's an answer.
delivery: low, definitive, with a slight shrug

name: API TEST
line: Look, I'm not on TV. I'm just a fan who actually watches and I'm telling you, this one's different. I've been saying that for a long time.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Api Test, I respect your watch. But 'different' is the first word in a story the tape hasn't finished telling.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Mm.

name: TASHA RAW
line: A head coach's call makes it a design flaw, not an accident.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Hm.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Hm.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Whew.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: The design's a choice. And the choice says they trust the room, not just one throne.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Trust the room all day. But your offensive captains are a guard and a running back. That's not leadership, that's a unit report.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Mm.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Tasha's looking for a crown. Api's looking for a change. Y'all both missing the foundation.

name: API TEST
line: typed only take

name: TASHA RAW
line: Api Test, you watch. I get it. But you have a guard and a back as offensive captains. That's an incomplete grade.
delivery: flat, direct, eye contact with camera

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: An incomplete grade is a teacher's problem. The Falcons gave us the syllabus. The identity is the lesson.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Proven veterans at the guard and back spots. So who exactly is running the offense on a third and long, then?

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: The quarterback's running the offense. The captain's running the culture. They told you which one they're building.
delivery: low, definitive, with a dry chuckle

name: TASHA RAW
line: Culture doesn't call the play. So who does when the clock's running?

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: The clock runs, the play gets called. The captain makes sure the huddle believes it.
delivery: low, definitive, with a slight shrug

name: API TEST
line: Honestly I would need to see it again, with fresh eyes.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Api Test, fresh eyes are fine. But the roster has seven captains and the offense still doesn't have a general.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Generals are for the battlefield. The Falcons are building a parliament. And parliaments last longer than wars.
delivery: low, definitive, with a slight nod

name: TASHA RAW
line: A parliament votes on the bill. The huddle needs a name to pay it.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Mm. The bill's been paid. The names are on the roster. The huddle just needs to trust the signature.

name: TASHA RAW
line: The signature's still a 'C' on a dotted line. An answer's missing.
